subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A report card is not only a record of grades.”?
options: Years later, it can become evidence that people change.
People cannot change a habit they cannot see.
Sometimes a small change helps more people than we first think.
The right words can change how people treat the same place.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「A report card is not only a record of grades. Years later, it can become evidence that people change.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「People cannot change a habit they cannot see.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes a small change helps more people than we first think.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The right words can change how people treat the same place.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A report card is not only a record of grades. Years later, it can become evidence that people change.」，答案為「Years later, it can become evidence that people change.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Years later, it can become evidence that people change.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
